_doc: Failures the harness-contract CI job accepts for now. See docs/harness-contract.md.

Every entry names the failure exactly (harness, kind, name), says why it is accepted, where ClawBox uses it (file:line when written; the job prints the current lines) and when it must be looked at again.
category 'version-guarded': written only for an older core generation, behind a guard in the code, so the pinned harness rightly lacks it.
category 'known-gap': a real gap at the pin, accepted until the date; fix it or bump the pin before then.
Tests (src/tests/, *.test.*, *.spec.*, e2e*/) are never scanned, so a string that only appears in a test needs no entry.
An entry that has expired, or that no longer matches a failure, fails the job: the list cannot outlive the reason for it.

entries.name: agents.defaults.compaction.reserveTokensFloor
entries.reason: OpenClaw 1 only: written in the `else` arm of `if openclaw_is_v2` in step_openclaw_config; OpenClaw 2 replaced it with compaction.mode and refuses it.

entries.name: gateway.controlUi.allowInsecureAuth
entries.reason: OpenClaw 1 only: both writes sit after `if openclaw_is_v2; then … return 0` in install-x64.sh's step_openclaw_patch and step_openclaw_config.

entries.name: approval.request
entries.reason: At v0.21.7 the dashboard asks for an approval with the server->client REQUEST `approval` (OpenRPC x-server-requests), sent only to a client that declares it can answer; ClawBox's dashboard client does not, so Hermes withdraws the approval and this event handler never fires.

entries.name: clarify.request
entries.reason: At v0.21.7 a clarify question is the server->client REQUEST `clarify` (OpenRPC x-server-requests), not an event; ClawBox waits for an event that is never sent, and the question goes back to the agent undelivered.

entries.name: clarify.expire
entries.reason: Not in v0.21.7's dashboard contract at all; part of the same unimplemented clarify flow as clarify.request.

entries.name: clarify.respond
entries.reason: Not a method at v0.21.7 (the answer to the server->client `clarify` request is its JSON-RPC result); a call answers -32601. v0.22.1 adds it under x-canonical-methods with different params.
